blocks.text: Today you begin exploring the Amazon beyond the city. Waterways are still the main means of getting around here, so much of the journey is by boat.

After the excursions, you travel to Evolution Eco Lodge. The lodge is in the Acajatuba area, 69 km from Manaus, amid the waters of the Rio Negro. The journey takes about 1.5 hours by car, followed by approximately 25 minutes by motorboat.

Evolution Eco Lodge is designed for travellers who want to stay close to the natural surroundings of the Amazon. There are 14 cottages: 6 face the river and 8 face the jungle. Each sleeps up to 3 people and has 1 double bed and 1 single bed, air conditioning, an electric shower, a small fridge, a safe, a balcony and a veranda with hammocks.

Facilities include a bar, a restaurant, a floating jetty, a playground, hammocks, a games room, a reading room, an event space, jungle camping and Wi-Fi. Excursions are led in Portuguese and English by bilingual guides, some of whom specialise in biology, geography and regional anthropology.

Overnight at Evolution Eco Lodge.

The Brazilian Amazon: a river bend in the rainforest
Evolution Eco Lodge: jungle walk, Caboclo home and Acajatuba

After breakfast, you go for a walk in the jungle. Take in the details of the forest: the humid air, the calls of birds and insects, the river close by and the dense vegetation along the trails.

The programme includes a visit to a Caboclo home. You learn about local life, traditions and customs and see how cassava flour is made.

After lunch, you visit the village of Acajatuba. Residents fish and farm, growing cassava, tucumã, açaí, palms, rubber trees and Brazil nuts. Local artisans make items from natural seeds, and you learn about their work during the visit.

A farewell dinner awaits when you return to the lodge.

At 20:00, you set out with torches on a night outing along the riverbanks. You may spot Tinga and Acu caimans and, with luck, nighthawks, snakes and frogs. The jungle feels quite different after dark, with black water, short beams of torchlight and sounds that are easy to miss during the day.

Overnight at Evolution Eco Lodge.
